sections.text:
✨ Premium Rice Chain Design: Fine textured links create a sleek, stylish, and luxurious look.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the Rice Chain around your neck as a stylish everyday jewellery accessory.
• Style it solo for a clean minimal look or layer it with pendants and other chains for a more fashionable stacked style.
• You can wear it with daily outfits, office looks, casual wear, party wear, festive styling, or evening looks.
• Use the lock closure properly to secure the chain comfortably around your neck.
• Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and anti-tarnish finish for longer.
• After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store it separately in a jewellery box or pouch.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 ✨ Gold & Silver Rice Chain

If you love jewellery that looks chic, stylish, and effortlessly premium, this Gold & Silver Rice Chain is made for you.

The Rice Chain is known for its fine textured link pattern that gives the chain a smooth, structured, and polished look around the neckline. Its sleek rice-style design adds a clean luxurious finish without looking too heavy or flashy, making it perfect for everyday styling as well as elevated looks.

Designed with a 3 mm width and 51 cm length, the 24k gold and silver-tone finish gives it a modern two-tone shine, while the durable chain structure makes it easy to wear again and again. Lightweight, anti-tarnish, and skin-friendly, this chain is designed for comfort, style, and long-lasting everyday use with proper care.

Wear it solo for a minimal statement or layer it with pendants and other chains for a more fashionable jewellery stack. A chic, versatile, and aesthetic chain that instantly makes your outfit look more polished.

Styling Tip: Pair it with a solid tee, shirt, dress, kurti, blazer, or layer it with a pendant for a clean and stylish two-tone jewellery look.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Is this Rice Chain suitable for daily wear?

Yes, this Rice Chain is lightweight, stylish, and comfortable, making it suitable for daily wear and special occasions.

Q2. Is it skin-friendly?

Yes, it is designed with a skin-friendly finish so it feels comfortable around the neck.

Q3. Is the chain anti-tarnish?

Yes, it has an anti-tarnish finish that helps maintain its shine with proper care.

Q4. Can I wear it with pendants?

Yes, you can wear it alone for a minimal look or layer it with pendants for a more stylish jewellery stack.

Q5. Is it suitable for gifting?

Yes, it makes a meaningful gift for anyone who loves chic, stylish, and luxurious jewellery.

Q6. How should I care for this chain?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. After use, wipe it gently with a soft dry cloth and store it separately.

Q7. Can it be styled with western and ethnic outfits?

Yes, it can be styled with shirts, t-shirts, dresses, kurtis, co-ord sets, festive outfits, and party wear.
